# Shed rebuild

## Plan

Replace the rotten floor first, then the roof felt. The frame is sound and stays as it is.

## Materials

Pressure-treated joists, eighteen millimetre exterior ply and a roll of heavy felt. Buy galvanised nails, since plain ones rust within a year.

## Order of work

1. Empty the shed and stack everything under a tarp
2. Lift the old floor and check the bearers
3. Lay the new joists and screw the ply down
4. Strip and replace the felt on a dry day
